notes.subject: חדשה
notes.rationale: Neuter 'new thing' — sword (KJV) vs new armor (JPS) vs merely 'a new one' (YLT); rendered here simply as 'kuraya' (a new thing) without specifying.

notes.subject: נחשת
notes.rationale: Literally copper/bronze; rendered 'nɛgɛ' (metal/iron), Bambara's common metal word.

notes.subject: sikidi kɛmɛ saba
notes.rationale: The spearhead's weight, three hundred shekels of bronze, is counted out.

notes.subject: miirira
notes.rationale: ויאמר להכות rendered as 'he intended to strike' — the saying-verb plus infinitive of intent compressed into one verb.

notes.subject: Yishbo-benob
notes.rationale: Hebrew names: 'Jishbo of Nob' vs 'Ishbi-benob' as a personal name vs 'the sons of Rapha'; the proper name is kept whole.

translation: Yishbo-benob (Ishbi-Benob) min bɔra Rafa denialenw la, a mɔgɔda sikidi jate tun ye nɛgɛ sikidi kɛmɛ saba ye; a y'a dalen kuraya la, a miirira ka ⟨את⟩ Dawid bɔnge.
